author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Today we FINALLY get to see the inside of a Smartphone Factory. Oppo is making their brand new Oppo Find X10 Pro Max - and we get to see where it begins its life inside a smartphone manufacturing facility.  Full specs on the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max are here: https://www.oppo.com/en/smartphones/series-find-x/find-x10-pro-max/

Have you ever wanted to see the inside of a smartphone factory? HUGE thanks to Oppo for letting us inside and sponsoring this factory tour.
